description.value: Guacamole Mexican Grill is a locally operated Mexican restaurant on King George Boulevard in Surrey, serving traditional Mexican specialties prepared with an emphasis on fresh ingredients. Situated on a major arterial road through Surrey, it offers a sit-down dining experience in a neighbourhood setting. Cyclists passing through the King George corridor would find this a convenient stop for a full meal.

address.value: 10671A King George Blvd, Surrey, BC V3R 5C9

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and provides a phone number, address with 'A' suffix, and email not present in OSM. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, takeout, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site. The website shows two different postal codes (V3R 5C9 in the footer, V3T 2X6 on the contact page), which is a minor data quality concern.
concerns: OSM address omits the 'A' unit suffix; website consistently shows '10671A King George Blvd' — OSM record may refer to the base building rather than the specific unit.
Two different postal codes appear on the website: V3R 5C9 (footer/about section) and V3T 2X6 (contact page) — the correct postal code should be verified.
OSM has no phone number; (604) 580-0840 sourced from website only.
OSM source tag references 'City of Surrey 2010 GIS Data' with a surrey:date of 1985-12-05, suggesting the OSM record is very old and may not reflect the current business accurately.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Business is confirmed open and operational, but none of the required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) could be verified from the website. A direct outreach or site visit is needed to confirm cyclist-relevant amenities before listing.
